methods.summary: This study measured five morphological traits (Weber’s length, relative eye length, relative scape length, relative mandible length, and relative hindleg length) and other measurements (head length, width, eye width, and pronotum width) on worker ants to be used for functional diversity analyses. The study measured the functional alpha and beta diversity of ant communities using incidence per plot, species richness, and two functional diversity indices (Petchey and Gaston’s FD and functional richness or FRic). discussion.summary: The study measured ant species richness and functional diversity indices across three transects in different regions, observing how these metrics changed with increasing elevation.
